title: Ingenua in Controversias Evangelicorum (Prefatio tip)
author: Samuel Strimesius
period: 1708 (Frankfurt an der Oder; Reformed Viadrina faculty)
edition: Ingenua in Controversias Evangelicorum (Francofurti ad Viadrum: Jer. Schrey & J. C. Hartmann, 1708). Google Books 3epYAAAAcAAJ (ONB). Tip: Prefatio Pacifico-Apologetica section I.
blurb: Samuel Strimesius — Prefatio tip from Ingenua in Controversias Evangelicorum (Frankfurt an der Oder, 1708): Nazianzen's cry for peace, the Philippians charge to both Evangelical parties, and Strimesius's 1679 Viadrina calling to weigh Protestant controversies only by Scripture toward peace. Tip only; the two-part body remains.
era_note: Strimesius wrote in the late seventeenth and early eighteenth centuries as Reformed doctor of theology and primary preacher in the church and university at Frankfurt an der Oder (Viadrina). This is not a patristic work. It is a public-domain Latin Reformed / Frankfurt (Oder) faculty retrieval on the same Fathers-site pipeline. The 1708 Schrey & Hartmann Latin is public domain. Do not treat the site as ante-Nicene only.

text_history.method: English follows the locked 1708 Francofurti ad Viadrum Latin of Prefatio section I, reconstructed from Google Books PDF page images (ONB copy, id 3epYAAAAcAAJ) with pdftotext as check. No modern English was copied. Sister Halle digitization of Ingenua in Arminianismum (DOI 10.25673/65287) was identified but Anubis-blocked for bulk agent download; Controversias is the Frankfurt faculty tip shipped.
